name: MultiHop-RAG
description: MultiHop-RAG is a benchmark dataset for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation systems on multi-hop queries. It includes a knowledge base, multi-hop queries, ground-truth answers, and supporting evidence, designed to test retrieval and reasoning over multiple evidence pieces.
reputation: A recent RAG benchmark that is useful for multi-hop retrieval and reasoning evaluation, but it is not yet a broadly established standard.
notes: Focuses on multi-hop queries requiring retrieval and reasoning over multiple evidence; existing RAG methods perform unsatisfactorily.
